protocol: Combat Edge condition. Randomized crossover, seated under positive-pressure oxygen. At least 60 min breathing 100% oxygen at ground level. After a 22,500-ft control, a brief excursion to 35,000 ft and return to 22,500 ft preceded rapid decompression to 60,000 ft in less than 0.6 s. Planned peak dwell up to 3 min. The same eight people underwent both conditions.
outcome_window: During the published study observation. Fixed clinical follow-up was not specified.
locator: Subjects p. 209; Procedures and Results p. 210 (PDF p. 2)
note: The zero applies to the published test series. Exact clinical surveillance duration and delayed follow-up are unspecified.
